mergedFrames.noFrames: No independent continuous presentation/no-frame timeline; guest flip intervals only. Missing time outside the retained windows is unmeasured.

scope: Observed retained events only; no cross-process causation or before/after gameplay benchmark. Durations of nested operations overlap.

app.clockAndPid: Mixed history without reliable per-line native clock/PID; no causal join attempted.

limitations: No controlled before/after gameplay pair or reliable cinematic/gameplay labels.
Thread wait sums overlap across threads and with caller operations; never sum them as a single visible pause.
Sampled footprint includes compressed accounting; VMA requests and aliases are not independent physical allocations.
Old NeoSwap sessions without clock anchors cannot be causally aligned to this process.
Current session contains no managed archive activity: device fsync-removal effect, dirty-page cost and restore latency remain unmeasured.
